title: Update Makefile/Kbuild for two-module build
description:
Update build system to produce two modules: crypto2dev.ko and crypto2dev_wolfssl.ko.

obj-m := crypto2dev.o crypto2dev_wolfssl.o

crypto2dev-objs: main, registry, cdev, fd (no wolfCrypt sources)
crypto2dev_wolfssl-objs: all src/providers/wolfssl/*.o

WOLFCRYPT_DIR only needed for crypto2dev_wolfssl build. crypto2dev.ko must build without WOLFCRYPT_DIR.

Stub mode (CRYPTO2DEV_HAVE_WOLFCRYPT=0): skip crypto2dev_wolfssl target entirely.

Depends on: wolfssl provider extraction issue
